templates.why_chosen: Three same-scale baseline architectures (Digital PUM, Analog PUM, Naive Hybrid PUM) reuse one crossbar-array icon throughout so structural differences, an off-chip CPU link versus stacked on-chip controllers, are directly comparable panel to panel.
templates.what_to_learn: Reuse the identical crossbar-array icon at the same visual scale across every alternative-design panel so the eye compares structure, not icon style, and letter the panels (a)(b)(c) with short claim titles naming each design; pair the figure with the performance numbers it motivates, since the panels alone (a listed weakness) omit that data.

templates.why_chosen: High-confidence rank-16 pick: three miniature floorplans (digital PUM, analog PUM, naive hybrid) reuse one crossbar-array icon and an orange-versus-blue palette to compare baseline chip layouts side by side.
templates.what_to_learn: Reuse the same building-block icon and a two-color code across side-by-side variant panels so structural differences read without a legend, elide repeated array rows with a vertical ellipsis instead of drawing every tile, and route the one off-chip link as a distinct colored connector outside the array.
